🎬 A Mile in His Shoes (2011)

A Mile in His Shoes tells the inspiring and heartwarming story of Mickey Tussler, a young man with autism whose extraordinary talent for pitching baseball is discovered by Arthur Murphy, the manager of a struggling minor league baseball team. Despite Mickey’s incredible abilities, his difficulty communicating with others and adjusting to unfamiliar environments makes joining the team a major challenge. Determined to help Mickey reach his full potential, Arthur gives him an opportunity to prove himself on the baseball field, even as skeptical teammates, opponents, and family pressures threaten his confidence. As Mickey begins developing friendships and discovering his own strengths, his journey inspires those around him to look beyond their assumptions and recognize the importance of acceptance and understanding. Starring Luke Schroder, Dean Cain, George Canyon, and Chilton Crane, the film delivers an emotional and uplifting story about determination, kindness, friendship, overcoming obstacles, and believing in someone when others refuse to see their potential.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Sports • Family • Inspirational

⭐ IMDb: 6.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 1h 29m • TV-PG

🎥 Director: William Dear

✍️ Writer: Jason Koornick

📚 Based On: The novel The Legend of Mickey Tussler by Frank Nappi.

⚾ Themes: Baseball, autism awareness, acceptance, perseverance, and second chances.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Tubi, and Apple TV for current streaming or rental availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: A Mile in His Shoes is a 2011 Canadian made-for-television sports drama film directed by William Dear and starring Luke Schroder, George Canyon and Dean Cain. It was based on the 2008 novel The Legend of Mickey Tussler by Frank Nappi. The setting was changed from Ohio in 1948 in the novel to Bargersville, Indiana in 2002 in the film.
